sources.snippet: Download millions of 3D models and files for your 3D printer, laser cutter, or CNC. From custom parts to unique designs, you can find them on Thingiverse.

sources.snippet: afriberta_base Model description AfriBERTa base is a pretrained multilingual language model with around 111 million parameters. The model has 8 layers, 6 attention heads, 768 hidden units and 3072 feed forward size.
